description: This Java class 'NoSecClient' implements a CoAP client for testing purposes within the Thingsboard project. It manages asynchronous requests to a CoAP server, handles responses, and provides a main method for execution with command-line arguments.

classes.name: NoSecClient
classes.description: A CoAP client class that sends requests asynchronously, processes responses, and supports command-line execution.

methods.name: NoSecClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CoAP client with a URI built from host, port, and security keys.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous task that repeatedly sends CoAP GET requests, processes responses, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: getFutureUrl
methods.description: Builds the CoAP URL with provided host, port, access token, and keys.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution, initializes the client with arguments, and starts testing.
